housing-numbers.notes: Total housing supply is 13,328 net additional homes. Required housing includes amount for local need (calculated using government's standard method) plus 5% allowance to reduce risk of sites not coming forward. Windfall figure based on historical average of 70 dwellings per year on sites under 5 units plus additional larger unidentified sites. Commitments are sites with extant planning permission as of 1 April 2021 (excluding site allocations).
